title: Broadcom taps Alphabet executive Amie Thuener as next CFO
title_zh: Broadcom 任命 Alphabet 高管 Amie Thuener 为下一任首席财务官
summary: U.S. chip designer Broadcom on Thursday named Alphabet executive Amie Thuener as its ‌next finance chief, effective June 12, when incumbent ‌Kirsten Spears retires. Thuener is currently Alphabet's vice president, corporate controller and ​chief accounting officer.
summary_zh: 美国芯片设计商 Broadcom 周四任命 Alphabet 高管 Amie Thuener 为下一任财务总监，该任命于 6 月 12 日生效，届时现任首席财务官 Kirsten Spears 退休。 Thuener 现任 Alphabet 副总裁、公司财务总监兼首席会计官。

title: Is OpenAI's $1 trillion IPO valuation realistic?
summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley breaks down OpenAI’s (OPAI.PVT) soaring valuation, competitive pressures, and the key question of whether ads or subscriptions will drive the artificial intelligence developer's path to profitability.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 详细分析了 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 飙升的估值、竞争压力，以及广告或订阅是否会推动人工智能开发商盈利的关键问题。

title: Airline stocks plunge as Iran war continues with no end in sight
title_zh: 由于伊朗战争持续且看不到结束的迹象，航空股暴跌
summary: Yahoo Finance's Jared Blikre and Ines Ferré chat with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about plunging airline stocks in the face of rising fuel costs as the Iran war continues to rumble on.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的贾里德·布利克雷 (Jared Blikre) 和伊内斯·费雷 (Ines Ferré) 与雅虎财经执行编辑布赖恩·索齐 (Brian Sozzi) 讨论了随着伊朗战争继续进行，面对燃油成本上涨导致航空股暴跌的问题。

title: Initial jobless claims unexpectedly fall as cooling labor market holds steady
title_zh: 随着劳动力市场降温保持稳定，首次申请失业救济人数意外下降
summary: Initial jobless claims unexpectedly fell to 202,000 for the week ended March 28.
summary_zh: 截至 3 月 28 日当周，首次申请失业救济人数意外降至 202,000 人。

title: Morning Brief: Labor market data vs. anecdotes
title_zh: 早间简报：劳动力市场数据与轶事
summary: Markets will be digesting President Trump's address and the Iran situation as a light day on the calendar features Challenger's job cuts, exports, and jobless claims.
summary_zh: 市场将消化特朗普总统的讲话和伊朗局势，因为挑战者号的裁员、出口和初请失业金人数是日历上轻松的一天。

title: SpaceX confidentially files for IPO
title_zh: SpaceX 秘密提交 IPO 申请
summary: SpaceX officially kicked off its IPO process, which could result in the biggest public offering ever.
summary_zh: SpaceX 正式启动 IPO 程序，这可能会成为有史以来规模最大的公开发行。
